marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Semiconductors
marketLayer.fact: Leading US cloud hyper-scalers reported elevated capital expenditure targets dedicated to AI server infrastructure, driving continued upward earnings revisions for major semiconductor vendors.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capex spend reinforces valuation support for hardware supply chain leaders, though market focus is gradually shifting toward profitability metrics and free cash flow conversion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Enterprise AI monetization trajectory and potential supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet & Platform Economy
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech leaders expanded active share buyback programs while integrating localized generative AI tools to improve user retention and advertisement targeting efficiency.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive capital return strategies establish a valuation floor, while operational efficiency gains help cushion revenue pressure from cautious domestic consumer sentiment.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Price competition dynamics in domestic e-commerce services and potential regulatory developments in cross-border trade.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: Recent US macroeconomic prints indicate moderating core inflation alongside stable labor market metrics, leading futures markets to price in high probability of near-term rate cuts.
marketLayer.inference: Easing yield environment reduces capital costs for mid-cap growth equities and enhances global cross-border capital allocations toward Asian emerging markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistence of services sector inflation and fiscal supply impact from US Treasury issuance schedules.

marketLayer.title: HK High-Yield & State-Owned Enterprises
marketLayer.fact: Southbound capital via Stock Connect demonstrated consistent net inflows into high-dividend Hong Kong telecommunications and energy SOEs during intraday trading.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional investors continue favoring defensive assets with transparent payout ratios to hedge against macroeconomic volatility and low domestic bond yields.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: HIBOR volatility affecting local liquidity conditions and foreign exchange fluctuations in USD/HKD peg maintenance.
